title: 一道菜带火一座城③天水麻辣烫：一条视频118万赞，烫红一座城 | One Dish One Town P3 · Tianshui 🌶️
description:
麻辣烫的灵魂，你投辣椒还是投麻酱？评论区说说。

【一道菜带火一座城·第3集 天水麻辣烫】2024年2月13日，一位天水本地人发的麻辣烫视频拿下118万点赞，一夜之间把甘肃这座西北小城"烫"红了。它的灵魂是甘谷辣椒——热油一泼，香而不燥；再配上秦安的手擀粉，一勺红亮的辣子浇下去就是招牌。那个3月，天水累计接待游客约464万人次、旅游综合收入约27亿元，甘谷辣椒粉的销量涨了超过10倍。淄博靠社交网络用了一个五一，天水更快——一条视频，就够了。

Ep.3 Tianshui. On Feb 13, 2024, a local's malatang clip hit 1.18M likes and set this small northwestern town ablaze. Its soul is Gangu chili — hot oil poured over it, fragrant not harsh — with hand-rolled noodles from Qin'an, finished with a glowing spoon of chili oil. That March, Tianshui logged ~4.64M visits and ~2.7B yuan in tourism; Gangu chili-powder sales rose over tenfold. Zibo needed a holiday; Tianshui needed only one video.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & travel note, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
